description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for different editing methods, with the x-axis labeled "Co-occurrence Number" on a logarithmic scale ranging from 0 to 10^3, marked at intervals of 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3, and the y-axis labeled "ACC (%)" on a linear scale from 60 to 80, marked at intervals of 5. Six lines are shown, representing different editing methods: Base (black, solid line, circle marker), FT (blue, solid line, inverted triangle marker), IKE (red, solid line, triangle marker), MEND (brown, solid line, diamond marker), MEMIT (purple, solid line, square marker), and ROME (green, solid line, square marker). The Base line starts at around 61 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to approximately 69 at 3 × 10^3. The FT line begins at around 61.5 at 3 and rises to about 71 at 3 × 10^3. The IKE line commences at roughly 66 at 3 and reaches approximately 72.5 at 3 × 10^3. The MEND line starts at around 69 at 3 and ascends to about 78.5 at 3 × 10^3. The MEMIT line begins at approximately 68 at 3 and increases to around 76 at 3 × 10^3. The ROME line starts at roughly 74 at 3 and rises to approximately 84 at 3 × 10^3. All lines exhibit an upward trend across the x-axis.
